name: obsidian-anchor-actions
description: Obsidian plugin: select text, an image or canvas cards and run any command from a small strip next to the selection.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2020 --external:obsidian --external:electron --external:@codemirror/view --external:@codemirror/state --outfile=dist/main.js && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/

author: Kenta Ninomiya
